title: 法巴首席经济学家：5%不是天花板，长端利率还有上行空间？
speaker: Luigi Speranza

segments.en: And obviously, we've seen a, I wouldn't say a de-anchoring, but certainly long end rates have risen quite substantially.
segments.zh: 显然，我们看到，我不会说脱锚，但长端利率确实大幅上升。

segments.en: That has to do more with the debt burden. It looks like the economy is doing well.
segments.zh: 这更多与债务压力有关。看起来经济表现不错。

segments.en: How worried should we be over the US being able to cope with this debt burden?
segments.zh: 我们该多担心美国能否应对这一债务压力？

segments.en: If the economy, as you put it, is actually, you know, you cannot grow, you cannot grow your debt anyway if you're growing. Yeah. I think look at this premium on the fiscal side, it's still contained.
segments.zh: 如果经济，如你所说，实际上，你知道，你不能增长，如果你在增长，债务也无法增长。是的。我认为财政方面的溢价仍然可控。

segments.en: I think this is very much more the story of real growth. It's a real growth, so I think.
segments.zh: 我认为这更多是实际增长的故事。这是实际增长，所以我认为。

segments.en: I think, fundamentally, it's a real growth story. There is an element of Fed credibility being questioned, which, you know, if the Fed increased rates, it's in soundocus, we can have a consolidation.
segments.zh: 我认为，从根本上说，这是实际增长的故事。有美联储信誉受质疑的成分，如果美联储加息，声音足够，我们可以有整固。

segments.en: But I guess it's a real story. Now, the key risk is that we are moving towards the narrative of concern over fiscal trends, not just in the US, a bit everywhere.
segments.zh: 但我猜这是真实的故事。现在，关键风险是我们正走向对财政趋势的担忧叙事，不仅在美国，各地都有一些。

segments.en: But that's a risk, I would say. So our view at this point is, look, we had a target of 5%. So we reached the target.
segments.zh: 但我会说，那是一个风险。所以我们目前的观点是，看，我们曾有一个5%的目标。我们达到了目标。

segments.en: I would keep it sort of bearish bias here.
segments.zh: 我会在这里保持偏空的倾向。

segments.en: So our strategy would prefer, if you want to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to, to effectively, this is on the yield curve.
segments.zh: 所以我们的策略更倾向于，如果你愿意，实际上，这是在收益率曲线上。

segments.en: On the yield curve, absolutely. So it's, it's, it's, it's a preferred short stretch, or it's in rallies, rather than buying in dips.
segments.zh: 在收益率曲线上，绝对。所以是，倾向于在反弹时做空，而不是在下跌时买入。

segments.en: I mean, that's under the story. So I think 5% is not the ceiling.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，这就是故事。所以我认为5%不是天花板。

segments.en: Okay. If one wants to say hi. Okay. 5% is not the ceiling, Luigi. That's interesting. Because if the Fed does actually hike, as you say, could that be a stable enough anchor for the long enough curve?
segments.zh: 好的。如果有人想说嗨。好的。5%不是天花板，路易吉。这很有趣。因为如果美联储确实如你所说加息，那能否成为长端曲线足够稳定的锚？

segments.en: Yeah, I think it can lead to some consolidation, absolutely. Because it would reduce a bit of the kind of risk of the Fed losing credibility here.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为这可能导致一些整固，绝对。因为这会稍微降低美联储失去信誉的风险。

segments.en: But to me, it's a probably an opportunity to go short again in any rally, in any consolidation.
segments.zh: 但对我来说，这可能是任何反弹、任何整固中再次做空的机会。

segments.en: Because the fundamental story is still about growth, about inflation risk, about some fiscal premium, which I think is not fully priced in at this stage.
segments.zh: 因为基本面故事仍然是关于增长、通胀风险、一些财政溢价，我认为目前尚未完全定价。
